title: Birth Control Pill
summary: The birth control pill is a daily hormonal tablet that prevents pregnancy mainly by stopping ovulation. It's about 91–93% effective in typical use and doesn't protect against STIs.
key_points: Some medicines and vomiting can affect it.
Side effects and suitability vary — a doctor helps choose.
